newsitem.title: USA: Admor Memory Corp plans Price Point buy.
newsitem.headline: Admor Memory Corp plans Price Point buy.

text.p: Admor Memory Corp said it had signed a letter of intent to acquire Price Point Microtechnologies, a full-service manufacturer and independent distributor of computer memory products and peripherals.
Admor said in statement the acquisition will be an all stock transaction and is tentatively scheduled to be completed by December 31.
It said Price Point will operate as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Admor.
Admor specialises in manufacturing, assembling, marketing and distributing equipment and aftermarket add-on memory products for PCS, workstations, notebooks and printers.
